answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 238 Country: United Kingdom Title: A women is in Mecca in the state of her period (haidh). She already has her Ihram on. When she is paak, is it necessary fo her to go to the Meeqat (Masjid-e-Aisha) for her to start her umrah, or can she go directly to the Haram? Question: A women is in Mecca in the state of her period (haidh). She already has her Ihram on. When she is paak, is it necessary fo her to go to the Meeqat (Masjid-e-Aisha) for her to start her umrah, or can she go directly to the Haram? Answer ID: 238 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 372/B) She is in a state of Ihram already, so when she is tahir (clean), she can do Tawaf and Sai after having a bath. She does not need to go Masjid-e-Aisha . It is allowed to do Tawaf and Sai from the Ihram that is already on. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
